summary: iter37 — Pro signup with 2-step form + CompleteProfileModal + profile prefill. Backend PUT /api/my/profile: 4/4 pytest PASS (401 no-session, 422 missing fields, 200 saves+returns, GET /auth/me reflects). Frontend /signup step indicator (signup-steps) + step1 form validation (mismatch→'Passwords don't match', weak→'Password is too weak', strong→step2) verified. Step 2 (signup-details-form) renders ProfileFields: phone/address/city/country required, optional block with hotel/travel-from/travel-to/heard-from/optin all present with correct testids; signup-back returns to step1 and preserves name. Turnstile is configured in preview → signup-submit stays disabled until a token exists (as expected per task). CompleteProfileModal auto-opens on / and /my-bookings for a signed-in no-profile user, does NOT open on /signup; complete-profile-close dismisses it for the session (survives reload via sessionStorage); complete-profile-save with required fields saves + modal closes + toast 'Profile saved'. ProfileCard on /my-bookings shows phone/address/hotel/travel-dates; account-profile-edit opens pre-filled modal and saves successfully (card updated to Freeport). Booking modal on /taxi prefills Full name, Email, Phone for a signed-in customer with a profile. Mobile 390px: /signup step 2 and the modal render well. ESLint on all 5 changed files: no issues.

integration_issues.issue: pickup_location is prefilled in form state from authUser.profile.hotel, but on routes where pickup is a <select> of predefined locations (e.g. LPIA Airport→Downtown Nassau), 'Baha Mar' doesn't exist as an option so the select visibly shows 'Select pickup…'. Name/email/phone prefills work correctly. Low priority — expected on fixed-route legs but worth validating against the hotel options list or only prefilling for free-text pickup legs.

action_items: Optional: Pickup prefill from profile.hotel only visibly populates when the booking leg uses a free-text pickup (not a <select> list). Consider either matching hotel string to the select's options when possible, or only applying the prefill on free-text legs.
critical_code_review_comments: Signup.jsx line 44: `await api.put('/my/profile', profile)` after register — if this throws (network, 422), the catch block silently swallows it. User still lands on /my-bookings and the CompleteProfileModal re-asks. Current behaviour is fine for UX but a `console.warn` would help future debugging. Low priority.

ProfileFields validates on the client via profileMissing(); backend also validates via Pydantic (min_length 7 for phone, 3 for address, 2 for city/country). No E.164 or phone-format regex — any 7+-char string is accepted. Twilio will reject malformed phones at send-time; consider a lightweight regex or using libphonenumber on the client before submit.

CompleteProfileModal auto-open uses `!pathname.startsWith('/signup') && !pathname.startsWith('/admin')`. If a future route like `/signupxyz` or `/admin-public` appears, the startsWith will also match and silently hide the modal. Use exact `pathname === '/signup' || pathname.startsWith('/admin/')` for safer matching.

sessionStorage 'rox_profile_later' is set globally — if the same browser signs out and a different user signs in during the same tab session, the new user won't see the modal until the tab is closed. Edge case, low priority. Consider scoping by user_id.

PasswordStrengthMeter.scorePassword penalises passwords that START with 'password'/'qwerty'/'admin'/etc., which can be surprising ('Password!23' is flagged weak). Working as designed but a dedicated hint ('don't start with common words') under the input would help users.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of iter37 flows (step1 validation, step2 UI, modal auto-open/close/dismiss, modal save, ProfileCard, edit, booking prefill, mobile)

Note: once a no-profile user clicks complete-profile-save, their DB row flips to profile_completed=true permanently, so for repeat runs reset or seed a fresh TEST_u_ user. Turnstile sitekey is configured in preview, so the signup submit button stays disabled until a real token comes in; UI validation of required-field missing message cannot be triggered via the submit button in that preview — tested via Back-preserves-name + testid presence instead.
